explication: This repository is a catalog of optional OpenTelemetry Collector Contrib components, not one standalone application. Its principal product workflow is that a Collector distribution assembles components into a telemetry pipeline, where signals can be transformed or routed and then exported. The tree also includes a supervisor executable, a telemetry-generation CLI, and storage extensions. The README describes the component ecosystem; sampled source confirms selected implementations, but not the wiring of unsampled components or a complete Collector pipeline.
